title: Fourier coefficient bounded by restricted weight
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $J$ and $U$ be sets of coordinates. Let $S$ be a subset of $J$ equal to the part of $U$ lying in $J$. Then the square of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $U$ is at most the restricted Fourier weight of $f$ on $J$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$J$ and $U$ are finite sets of coordinates
the part of $U$ lying in $J$ equals $S
